A is better. It stays under the 120-word limit, at roughly 114 words. It also uses the corrected figures ($88,200 approved, $31,800 rollover) and notes the correction to the Saltwater amount.

B has the correct figures too, but it is well over the limit, at about 180 words. It opens with filler ("Thank you for reviewing the update below...") that a busy manager doesn't need.
